counties.name: Churchill County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the museum request or the cave visit before planning the group’s arrival.
counties.rationale: Three organizer routes and a museum-first caravan sequence make the request and arrival review concrete. Unlike Okanogan, the key handoff is a staged physical journey and the museum form explicitly excludes the cave.

counties.name: Clark County
counties.readerDecision: Separate a mine tour from a photo shoot or other use of the site.
counties.rationale: Gallery entry and non-professional photography are tested against a separate site-use inquiry. This is not another minimum-party tour brief.

counties.name: Douglas County
counties.readerDecision: Keep grounds access, open-house dates and a private guided visit separate.
counties.rationale: Grounds, dated all-ages interior openings and restricted private tours receive separate maintenance and age-condition checks. The dated-visit expiry exercise adds practical preparation.

counties.name: Elko County
counties.readerDecision: Route an education inquiry to the organization that runs the selected program.
counties.rationale: An approved education-program record combines audience, season, organizer and action, tested on a company-scheduled school program and a public family activity. External routing itself is not novel.

counties.name: Esmeralda County
counties.readerDecision: Show the end date as well as the start time for an overnight experience.
counties.rationale: A Friday-to-Saturday finish and guided-hour versus whole-visit duration require specific content fields and a season-boundary check; generic booking timing does not replace that exercise.

counties.name: Eureka County
counties.readerDecision: Choose a room layout or recreation booking type before using a capacity or price.
counties.rationale: The Opera House layout and pool-party alternatives provide ordinary capacity/category distinctions already worked through in Stearns and McKenzie. No additional developed project is supported by these inspected leads; no population criterion applied.

counties.name: Humboldt County
counties.readerDecision: Compare room arrangement and movement between sessions before choosing a hall.
counties.rationale: An agenda connects simultaneous sessions, room levels, divided spaces and equipment. The multi-level movement question and concurrent-session exercise add useful planning beyond a maximum-capacity table, though room-sequence advice already exists.

counties.name: Lander County
counties.readerDecision: Identify the locally applicable swim group and enrollment route; separately distinguish present museum visits from a planned expansion.
counties.rationale: The independently completed Cookhouse alternative supports a bounded current-versus-proposed no-addition result. The swim-label mapping remains unresolved and excluded; it is not declared solved. Eastland is an additional direct present-versus-future comparison.

counties.name: Lincoln County
counties.readerDecision: Describe the campsite’s seasonal utilities separately from campground access.
counties.rationale: The owner must distinguish individual hookups, shared water, other seasonal facilities and site-category reservation actions. This adds a workable facility inventory beyond simply applying a closure notice.

counties.name: Lyon County
counties.readerDecision: Resolve kitchen approval and preparation before treating the room as ready for food service.
counties.rationale: Building-specific kitchen approval, office-hours appliance instruction and staffing across preparation/cleanup form a real project sequence. Unlike Franklin, this is event preparation after choosing a venue, not food-business onboarding.

counties.name: Mineral County
counties.readerDecision: Name who will operate and return equipment before requesting an off-site loan.
counties.rationale: The location of equipment use changes responsibility and the collection/return conversation. Named off-site responsibility and room-key preparation do not grant borrower competence.

counties.name: Nye County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the appropriate party-size contact route and understand the reservation-change cutoff.
counties.rationale: The winery party thresholds and the separate cancellation-cutoff alternative do not produce a developed extra project beyond existing group and booking instructions. This is a bounded decision, not absence of possible county businesses.

counties.name: Pershing County
counties.readerDecision: Treat each recurring event as a separate key collection and return cycle.
counties.rationale: A returning organizer must return keys after each accepted event and arrange the next handoff. The two-occurrence custody test differs usefully from obtaining approval for a series, although it substantially overlaps prior key-access advice.

counties.name: Storey County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish launching a weekday tour from joining one already arranged.
counties.rationale: Establishing a weekday departure and joining an established one use different party and deadline questions. That state change is distinct from Klickitat minimum charging and ordinary event-wide minimums.

counties.name: Washoe County
counties.readerDecision: Separate school admission eligibility from the steps needed to arrange a bus.
counties.rationale: School admission category is separated from district-bus authorization and the confirmed-visit-to-school-booked-bus sequence. The three institution cases expose meaningful handoff differences.

counties.name: White Pine County
counties.readerDecision: Separate the event being arranged from travel-professional onboarding.
counties.rationale: Event service and purchaser role are independent axes. A private charter inquiry need not become trade onboarding; tax documents remain outside the general form.

counties.name: Carson City
counties.readerDecision: Choose the group visit before applying public hours or adding a ride.
counties.rationale: Group-specific days can differ from public hours, while rides remain separately conditional. The school, younger-class and adult motorcar cases provide a complete group-planning exercise.

counties.name: Adams
counties.readerDecision: Keep every requested area in the event brief.
counties.rationale: The request retains multiple areas, different fee bases and an adjacent independent operator when a space changes. That combined-event brief adds to ordinary single-room comparison.

counties.name: Asotin
counties.readerDecision: Let the completed payment step determine the arrival instructions.
counties.rationale: Operator-confirmed payment can remove a physical office stop. The before/after message test is materially different from merely publishing the correct dock address.

counties.name: Benton
counties.readerDecision: Keep class size separate from the size of the whole visit.
counties.rationale: Class-level limits and price units coexist with a separate simultaneous-visit ceiling. A 60-pupil request retains both actual attendance and unresolved grouping, without inventing allocation.

counties.name: Chelan
counties.readerDecision: Build the wedding brief around the people who arrive at different times.
counties.rationale: Guest, wedding-party and supplier instructions have different times and facilities. Changing ceremony to reception prompts role-specific preparation rather than merely changing capacity.

counties.name: Clallam
counties.readerDecision: Compare room equipment before comparing available hours.
counties.rationale: Equal-capacity room alternatives differ by equipment, and the automatically blocked staff interval is not customer time. Both dimensions are necessary to the acceptance example.

counties.name: Clark
counties.readerDecision: Recheck the adult arrangements when a school visit changes season.
counties.rationale: A season change alters adult treatment and a session-count change alters the deposit unit. The revision example goes beyond a seasonal dates page.

counties.name: Columbia
counties.readerDecision: The independently located Dumas Station visit page distinguishes ordinary tasting, call-ahead seating and a separate Harvest Hosts RV stay. Complete Minnesota Douglas, Tennessee Hickman and Virginia Brunswick records already supply ordinary-versus-reserved visits, separately arranged extras and overnight/activity distinctions, with owner inputs and acceptance tests. Adding a membership name does not establish substantial new website-project guidance. Liberty Theater also repeats the complete Dodge/Eddy event-channel distinctions, but its retained homepage does not establish the street address used for geocoding; that lead is supplementary and is not relied on for county-complete evidence. No addition is justified by the inspected, fully located winery route; this is not a claim about all county businesses.
counties.rationale: The located Dumas tasting/reserved-seating/overnight alternative is covered by complete Douglas, Hickman and Brunswick projects. Theater address linkage, dated Bluewood terms and contradictory shipping claims remain excluded.

counties.name: Cowlitz
counties.readerDecision: The museum’s limited online catalogue and curator-assisted research repeat complete Otter Tail, Coffey and Floyd guidance on incomplete digitization and staff follow-up. Its separate substantive education offer supplies classroom presentations versus on-site/custom tours, county-dependent travel expenses and unavailable dates. Complete Deaf Smith and Montgomery already separate educational formats and host locations; Harvey treats education-related travel and follow-up; Clatsop carries program-specific dates into the request. Changing the local cost boundary and holiday interval does not create substantial new owner-facing project guidance. This is a bounded no-addition decision for the inspected leads, not a claim about all county businesses.
counties.rationale: Incomplete catalog plus staff research, and classroom versus onsite educational delivery, are covered by complete Otter Tail/Deaf Smith and retained batch comparisons. The out-of-county nursery is excluded rather than counted as local support.

counties.name: Douglas
counties.readerDecision: Route a lost-item question by where the item was last seen.
counties.rationale: A post-visit lost-item task uses last-seen location to choose a custodian and preserves an unsure/after-hours route. It is meaningfully different from selecting a tour organizer.

counties.name: Ferry
counties.readerDecision: Include the return visit in the collecting experience.
counties.rationale: The mandatory center-to-dig-to-center loop and staff review of take-home finds affect the onward itinerary. A quantity allowance does not promise release of particular finds.

counties.name: Franklin
counties.readerDecision: Show what is needed before the meeting and what follows it.
counties.rationale: The published pre/post-meeting boundary, owner of each stage and upcoming operator-change review make a concrete onboarding content commission. It strongly overlaps the shared-kitchen guide and should remain a local worked application, not a new guide.

counties.name: Garfield
counties.readerDecision: Keep the permission route attached to the exact land area.
counties.rationale: A maintained named-area/permission-owner table and destination-change test prevent one permit from implying access across neighboring authorities. This concerns area authority, not an activity bundle.

counties.name: Grant
counties.readerDecision: Use the full camping product name when equipment and support differ.
counties.rationale: Exact near-identical camping names carry opposite RV treatment; full product identity survives replacement and support checks. The text does not conflate the RV-name distinction with the separate support-provider distinction.

counties.name: Grays Harbor County
counties.readerDecision: Keep the moorage customer, vessel and slip request separate.
counties.rationale: Boat sale, customer contract and replacement-vessel suitability are distinct. The buyer and continuing customer cases produce more than a generic waitlist explanation.

counties.name: Island County
counties.readerDecision: Plan the occupied hours and usable spaces before the event schedule.
counties.rationale: Delivery-to-cleanup occupancy is combined with approved-room limits, catering-only kitchen use and weather-driven room/catering review. The combined acceptance checks are useful despite close prior access-timeline examples.

counties.name: Jefferson County
counties.readerDecision: Make course-specific preparation override a general tools-included message.
counties.rationale: The selected intensive course overrides general beginner tools-included language; inbound shipping and prepaid return responsibility are separate. The course-change example requires useful content maintenance.

counties.name: King County
counties.readerDecision: Explain what an inventory label lets a borrower do next.
counties.rationale: In-stock is not necessarily available to this borrower; item/type waitlist and reservation receipt/approval also differ. A branch-specific status glossary addresses a concrete catalog handoff.

counties.name: Kitsap County
counties.readerDecision: Separate entering the building, using a studio and helping on a project.
counties.rationale: The helper is a different person whose role can change from carrying to tool use. Building, studio and machine permission remain distinct; this is not Whatcom’s returning-member lapse case.

counties.name: Kittitas County
counties.readerDecision: Keep service orders, account authority and urgent calls on their own routes.
counties.rationale: Operational orders exclude general email/text, later calls have a handoff, and emergency contact is not an order queue. Representative authority is separately distinguished from transfer.

counties.name: Klickitat County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish a group discount threshold from a private-tour minimum charge.
counties.rationale: Actual attendance differs from minimum charge and discount eligibility. The eight-person example preserves the true count while showing a ten-person charge basis; it does not duplicate departure minimum advice.

counties.name: Lewis County
counties.readerDecision: Explain what is private before a group chooses its train ride.
counties.rationale: Privacy can concern seats, one car or an entire charter; program discounts have a different scope. A private carriage and a school group are tested without promising a private train.

counties.name: Lincoln County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the processing instruction route before asking for extra cuts.
counties.rationale: A fixed standard option rejects additional cuts, so a changed request must revisit its instruction document. Conflicting deadline triggers stay excluded rather than invented.

counties.name: Mason County
counties.readerDecision: Show which part of the business is open before asking for a reservation.
counties.rationale: Shopping and dining have separate schedules and party routes, and late arrival does not move the reservation end. The combined chooser and timing example go beyond a generic open/closed notice.

counties.name: Okanogan County
counties.readerDecision: Match the activity and trail operator before linking a pass.
counties.rationale: Activity plus actual trail operator selects the pass issuer; equipment and instruction remain separate providers. Changing to Pearrygin reopens the pass question rather than copying an entitlement.

counties.name: Pacific County
counties.readerDecision: Describe the work method before treating a boatyard space as permission.
counties.rationale: A haul/space arrangement is not approval of a changed work method. An unknown-method option and changed-preparation review are useful website intake choices without operational work instructions.

counties.name: Pend Oreille County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish an existing-service transfer from other connection requests.
counties.rationale: Existing service transferred to POVN is distinguished from existing physical fiber or new occupancy. Uncertain property status and wireless alternatives receive staff review without fee or installation promises.

counties.name: Pierce County
counties.readerDecision: Can a museum visitor choose self-guided access, a guided route or a separate driving experience from the information available?
counties.rationale: Guided/self-guided building access and the short Model T alternative do not add a sufficiently developed project. Complete Oklahoma Creek directly reinforces the Model T overlap; past dates are not promoted as current.

counties.name: San Juan County
counties.readerDecision: Explain a solo booking across boats, lodging and arrival.
counties.rationale: A solo customer can share a boat while having a separate camping tent; inn itineraries differ again. The component-by-component sharing and independent ferry test adds practical value.

counties.name: Skagit County
counties.readerDecision: Keep admission and flower quantities separate.
counties.rationale: Admission, bouquet/stem sale units and physical buckets are distinct. A two-bouquet example and a non-entry purchase branch test more than generic ticket extras.

counties.name: Skamania County
counties.readerDecision: Plan the accompanying guest as well as the participant.
counties.rationale: An observer may follow a trail or stay at a viewing point depending on activity. Participant and observer preparations are tested separately without promising they remain together.

counties.name: Snohomish County
counties.readerDecision: Show included access before offering a ticket upgrade.
counties.rationale: Ticket-free, general and timed-tour access are distinguished for both new buyers and existing ticket holders. Upgrade uncertainty and duplicate-purchase prevention add to ordinary factory/museum comparisons.

counties.name: Spokane County
counties.readerDecision: Connect vendor type, attendance dates and site needs.
counties.rationale: Vendor category, selected attendance dates and equipment footprint are retained together. The partial-season trailer request and expired-cycle check make the application brief usable.

counties.name: Stevens County
counties.readerDecision: Explain what changes across a multi-visit lesson package.
counties.rationale: Three visits have changing access, later-session scheduling and a separate purchase opportunity after completion. The sequence requires more than one static package description.

counties.name: Thurston County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish online stock from what is ready in the shop.
counties.rationale: Offsite online stock requires a physical transfer before collection. Order receipt, transfer and actual readiness are separate content/message states, unlike King’s borrower-specific hold.

counties.name: Wahkiakum County
counties.readerDecision: Separate booking today from arriving late on an existing booking.
counties.rationale: A new room-for-tonight inquiry and an existing guest’s late arrival are different tasks. Online cutoff is not sold-out evidence, and the request remains pending until accepted.

counties.name: Walla Walla County
counties.readerDecision: Explain earning and using rewards by transaction.
counties.rationale: The same club transaction can earn points but not redeem them; annual tier and retained points also differ. The transaction/year-change matrix is substantive and does not invent balances.

counties.name: Whatcom County
counties.readerDecision: Explain what a returning member must recheck.
counties.rationale: Cancellation creates a returning-member training-validity question independent of membership payment. An uncertain date goes to staff; this differs from a helper’s permissions at Kitsap.

counties.name: Whitman County
counties.readerDecision: Show how quantity and shipping conditions change the parcel plan.
counties.rationale: Five-to-six cans changes parcel count, while route conditions and dispatch govern another decision. The boundary test gives a concrete explanation without rate calculations.

counties.name: Yakima County
counties.readerDecision: Define what leaves production and what remains in storage.
counties.rationale: Starting materials and selected production stage are joined to bulk/case/dry-goods storage and release needs. The finished-cases-versus-bulk test keeps a genuine production handoff visible.
